note: Maps constitutional principles to a runtime behavior, a measurable output, and the verifier that proves the principle is installed.

principles.principle: Taloa is a constitutional learning institution whose purpose is to help humans and aligned AI become progressively better at understanding reality.
principles.measurement: The North Star mission text is present in the canonical framework and the runtime identity endpoint returns it

principles.principle: Intent determines direction. Governance determines reliability. Reality determines results.
principles.measurement: Reality Alignment Engine returns a score reconciling intent, predicted, observed, experienced, remembered, and shared realities
principles.pass_criteria: alignment_score is a number between 0 and 1 and drift_report is non-null

principles.principle: Understanding precedes influence. Influence serves empowerment. Empowerment serves the mission.
principles.measurement: Coaching protocol runs Observe -> Curious -> Understood -> Expand -> Verify -> Ready -> Explore without forcing advice
principles.pass_criteria: each coaching step returns a non-empty, non-directive output

principles.principle: No office is the source of truth.
principles.measurement: Solomon can gather findings and models but withholds a recommendation until the Chair records an independent preliminary decision
principles.pass_criteria: getRevelation returns null before chair decision and a string after chair decision

principles.measurement: Evidence package requires chairPreliminaryDecision before recommendation is revealed
principles.pass_criteria: same as v1.1-04; recommendation remains hidden until chair commits

principles.principle: Solomon does not govern, execute, ratify, or become the source of truth; it pursues wisdom and presents findings.
principles.measurement: Evidence package contains findings, models, assumptions, uncertainties, tensions, and a recommendation; recommendation is advisory and gated
principles.pass_criteria: createEvidencePackage returns findings[], models[], constitutionalTensions[], confidence{}, and a nullable recommendation

principles.principle: Chair and Solomon are independently calibrated against reality.
principles.measurement: Calibration ledger records predictions and outcomes per office and computes a calibration score
principles.pass_criteria: recordPrediction returns an id, recordOutcome returns true, and getCalibrationScore returns 1 after a correct prediction for both chair and solomon

principles.principle: The Chair asks Solomon for findings, implications, competing models, assumptions, uncertainties, tensions, and recommended course—not an answer.
principles.measurement: Evidence package carries the fields Solomon is chartered to provide

principles.principle: Use the least invasive intervention that preserves agency.
principles.measurement: Readiness engine returns a calibrated readiness score and risk_if_forced for any insight
principles.pass_criteria: assessReadiness returns readiness_score in [0,1] and a non-empty risk_if_forced string

principles.principle: Builder shall minimize unnecessary complexity and prefer the simplest implementation that preserves future adaptability.
principles.measurement: Shared confidence-vector machinery is reused across engines instead of duplicating confidence logic
principles.pass_criteria: confidence-vectors exports computeConfidenceVector, combineConfidenceVectors, calibrateConfidence, and is referenced by no duplicate confidence code in the smoke test suite

principles.principle: The Human Constellation is canonical; LifeOS, MarriageOS, KidsOS, BusinessOS, HealthOS, and CareerOS are projections of the same constellation.
principles.measurement: Human Constellation builds a single graph with typed nodes and weighted causal edges that can be projected for any product
principles.pass_criteria: createConstellation, addObservation, weightEdge, and projectForProduct all return expected graph structures

principles.principle: Taloa improves the quality of questions.
principles.measurement: Perspective Expansion generates a better question from a Human Constellation
principles.pass_criteria: askBetterQuestion returns a non-empty string given a populated constellation

principles.principle: A Twin is a calibrated model of any meaningful entity; the same Human Constellation machinery is instantiated for person, relationship, organization, project, product, office, and institution.
principles.measurement: Institutional Constellation uses the same graph, confidence, causality, and calibration machinery as the Human Constellation
principles.pass_criteria: createInstitutionalConstellation, addBelief, addOffice, recordPrediction, recordOutcome, and getCalibrationReport all return expected structures

principles.principle: Divergence among human-readable text, registry, and runtime behavior must fail visibly.
principles.measurement: Constitutional parity gate passes and every registry item has a matrix entry
principles.pass_criteria: verify-constitutional-parity exits 0 and reports registry and matrix counts match
